plan.title: Substrate Phase 3: transitions write their own state; per-issue record lock
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5-1

narratives.Problem: One project-wide record lock is held across a network push and taken in bursts by patrols, so an auto-handoff spawn starved on it (F1). Spawning takes the lock for a policy override it does not need. pan done leaves its review request for a patrol to guess at (104 of 256 PR-bearing records carry panDoneRecoveredAt). Reviewer exit is inferred by patrols instead of written by the reviewer. A dozen scavenger patrols and a verdict fallback file exist to repair states that a synchronous write would never produce.
narratives.Proposal: Key the record lock per issue and release it before the push; take no lock at spawn; make pan done write prUrl and reviewRequestedAt in one record write with a loud escalation when the write fails; have the reviewer launcher write stopped through pan admin agents exited; add would-have-fired counters and a shadow soak; delete reconcileInFlightJournals, the verdict fallback, checkOrphanedCompletions and the remaining Phase 3 scavenger patrols one commit each behind their audits; keep reconcilePendingPromotions; document.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to complete-planning retry semantics; patrol #10 reconcilePendingPromotions stays.
- No deletion of any patrol whose would-fire counter is non-zero during the soak.
- No change to the merge door or post-merge lifecycle.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD W25 in drafts/pan-3848.md, after w30 is merged. Checkpoint: grep reviewRequestedAt in done.ts and request-review-pipeline.ts to find the current write.
